description: NDA review — Review a non-disclosure agreement for the receiving, disclosing or mutual party (party=receiving default): NDA type MUTUAL / ONE_WAY, parties, purpose, term, how long confidentiality survives, governing law, dispute resolution, which party the terms favor, red flags with severity and suggested edits, unusual terms, a plain-English summary and a risk level LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH. An offline checklist confirms the standard clauses (definition, public / prior-knowledge / independent-development / third-party exclusions, compelled disclosure, return or destruction, no license, remedies, governing law, assignment, no warranty) and flags non-solicit, non-compete and residuals clauses. Params: text (the NDA, up to 24,000 characters), optional party. Not legal advice. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description: e.g. MUTUAL NONDISCLOSURE AGREEMENT. This Agreement is entered into by Acme Inc. and Beta LLC to evaluate a potential business relationship (the Purpose). Confidential Information means any non-public information disclosed by either party. Confidential Information does not include information that is publicly available, already known to the recipient prior to disclosure, independently developed, or rightfully received from a third party without restriction. The recipient may disclose information if required by law or court order after notice. Upon request each party shall return or destroy all Confidential Information. Nothing herein grants any license. Obligations survive for 3 years. For 12 months neither party shall solicit the other's employees. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.
